title.zh: 将卡林加省 Tinglayan 市镇 Ambato-Legleg 描笼涯的卡林加 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Tinglayan 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Kalinga National High School – Ambato Tinglayan Annex in Barangay Ambato-Legleg, Municipality of Tinglayan, Province of Kalinga From the Kalinga National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Tinglayan National High School and Appropriate Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Ambato Tinglayan của Trường Trung học Kalinga Quốc gia tại Barangay Ambato-Legleg, Đô thị Tinglayan, Tỉnh Kalinga khỏi Trường Trung học Kalinga Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Ambato Tinglayan ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Kalinga แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Ambato-Legleg เทศบาล Tinglayan จังหวัด Kalinga ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Kalinga แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Ambato Tinglayan, Sekolah Menengah Kalinga Nasional di Barangay Ambato-Legleg, Kotamadya Tinglayan, Provinsi Kalinga dari Sekolah Menengah Kalinga Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Ambato Tinglayan, Sekolah Menengah Kalinga Kebangsaan di Barangay Ambato-Legleg, Perbandaran Tinglayan, Wilayah Kalinga daripada Sekolah Menengah Kalinga Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan

text.en: The Kalinga National High School-Ambato Tinglayan Annex in Barangay Ambato-Legleg, Municipality of Tinglayan, Province of Kalinga is hereby separated from the Kalinga National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Tinglayan National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Kalinga National High School-Ambato Tinglayan Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Tinglayan National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Tinglayan National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Kalinga National High School-Ambato Tinglayan Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
